name: Mention Me
description: Connect your Mention Me referral data to Claude and get instant answers without logging into a dashboard. Ask natural language questions about referral volumes, conversion rates, performance trends and how you benchmark against your vertical. Fast insights, right where you're already working. Requires an active Mention Me account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mention Me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mention Me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mention-me.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mention Me MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mention Me provides these MCP tools: fetch_campaign, fetch_campaigns, fetch_metric, fetch_metric_by_dimension, fetch_metric_series, fetch_metric_series_by_dimension, get_more_tools, and list_organizations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mention Me?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mention Me in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Mention Me MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mention Me requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mention Me is developed by Mention Me. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
